title: token_audit: USD per completed todo note
objective: The weekly token audit reports how many list-price dollars each finished todo note cost, by linking sessions to notes (note_claim.sh, todo-images prompts, fuzzy first prompt, handoff chains) and dating completions from the Firebase dumps.
acceptance_criteria: Join rules a-d, the done-date recovery and the metric math are covered by python_pkg/token_audit/tests/test_notes_*.py at 100% branch coverage
The audit snapshot metrics carry usd_per_note (absent when no linked done note), note_linked_usd_share and notes_done; WEEKLY.md gains a 'Cost per todo note' section
notes.json in the report dir lists every note with linked spend (id, title, status, priority, done_at, sessions, usd, tokens)
A 30-day audit including the notes stage finishes under 60 s
token_dashboard stores the build-class A/B (agent-ab-build.jsonl) as meta ab_build, separate from the judgment meta ab (tests/test_ab_build.py)
out_of_scope: python_pkg/app_icons changes in the working tree
verifier: python3 -m pytest -q -o addopts='' python_pkg/token_audit/tests --cov=python_pkg.token_audit --cov-branch; capped.sh env PYTHONPATH=$HOME/src/testsAndMisc python3 -m python_pkg.token_audit --since $(date -d '30 days ago' +%s) --no-write
